final: WITH station_averages AS (SELECT observstation, AVG(bandusagepct) AS station_avg FROM telescopes WHERE bandusagepct IS NOT NULL GROUP BY observstation), baseline AS (SELECT AVG(station_avg) AS baseline_avg FROM station_averages) SELECT AVG(s.station_avg) AS mean_above_baseline, AVG(s.station_avg - b.baseline_avg) AS mean_excess FROM station_averages s CROSS JOIN baseline b WHERE s.station_avg > b.baseline_avg
